description.narrative:
Youth Voice Naija is a comprehensive youth empowerment initiative that combines capacity building with policy advocacy to amplify young Nigerian voices in governance processes. The project will strengthen NGYouthSDGs' Youth Advisory Board by developing and delivering a self-paced youth policy course while simultaneously advocating for the effective design and implementation of Nigeria's National Youth Policy and the Nigerian Youth Employment Action Plan. Through this dual approach, the project will equip underrepresented young Nigerians aged 18-35 with policy literacy skills while creating structured pathways for their meaningful participation in shaping policies that directly affect their futures.
Project Goal: Empower 1,200 underrepresented youth with policy literacy and enablemeaningful participation in shaping and monitoring the National Youth Policy and Nigerian Youth Employment Action Plan.
Objectivesand Activities: Launch a self-paced policy course for 700+ youth, strengthen the Youth Advisory Board to advocate for youth-inclusive policies, secure at least five youth recommendations in policy, conduct consultations, workshops, and dialogues, produce youth-led policy briefs, and establish youth-led monitoring and sustainability mechanisms.

participating-org.narrative:
Network of Youth for Sustainable Initiatives (NGYouthSDGs) is a youth-led and youth-serving civil society organisation dedicated toensuring meaningful youth engagement in policies and programmes that enable young people to lead and thrive.
Our visionis a Nigeria where young people are aware of their rights and their power to drive change, collaborating with decision-makers to shape programmes and policies that reflect youth priorities.
Our mission is to champion this engagement by building youth capacity, facilitating participation, and creating platforms for influence.
NGYouthSDGs focuses on three core areas: Education and Leadership Development,Livelihoods and Employment, and Civic Participation.
Guided by the values of Collaboration, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation,and Sustainability, we operate a youth-led governance and operational model that places young people’s perspectives, lived experiences, and voices at the centre of all strategy, programme design, and advocacy initiatives.
NGYouthSDGs is led by young people across its Board, management, and programme teams, ensuring strategy, priorities, and partnerships reflect youth perspectives and lived experience. The organisation uses a dual advisory structure: the Main Advisory Board provides senior guidance and oversight, while the Youth Advisory Board (YAB) embeds youth voice into programme design, advocacy, and organisational strategy. Composed of diverse young leaders, especially from underrepresented groups, the YAB synthesises grassroots priorities and represents youth externally. Itsrecommendations are systematically integrated into management decisions, ensuring meaningful influence. NGYouthSDGs’ participatory approach positions young people as co-creators, facilitators, and policy actors, supported by consultations, feedback loops, and transparent reporting.
